changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0022. Challenges and an in-app notification inbox. A null challenge tenant is a system challenge. Participants are unique per challenge and user. Notifications are stored only; delivery is later. Index review: IX_Challenges_Tenant_Status for workspace lists; UX_ChallengeParticipants_Challenge_User; IX_Notifications_User_Unread for the inbox. Start and end dates are filters on an already tenant-scoped list, so they are not a separate index. Performance note: inbox reads unread rows for one user.

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE app.Notifications; DROP TABLE app.ChallengeParticipants; DROP TABLE app.Challenges;

changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0023. Seed Part 4 permissions and grant them through existing roles. PersonalOwner and Member can manage their own fitness data. Handlers still load rows by the current user and tenant. Index review: no new indexes. Performance note: the insert is a small catalog write.

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM app.RolePermissions WHERE PermissionId IN (SELECT Id FROM app.Permissions WHERE Code IN (N'FITNESS_READ', N'FITNESS_MANAGE', N'EXERCISE_READ', N'EXERCISE_MANAGE', N'WORKOUT_READ', N'WORKOUT_MANAGE', N'NUTRITION_READ', N'NUTRITION_MANAGE', N'AI_USE', N'CHALLENGE_READ', N'CHALLENGE_MANAGE', N'NOTIFICATION_READ')); DELETE FROM app.Permissions WHERE Code IN (N'FITNESS_READ', N'FITNESS_MANAGE', N'EXERCISE_READ', N'EXERCISE_MANAGE', N'WORKOUT_READ', N'WORKOUT_MANAGE', N'NUTRITION_READ', N'NUTRITION_MANAGE', N'AI_USE', N'CHALLENGE_READ', N'CHALLENGE_MANAGE', N'NOTIFICATION_READ');
